Gaining skill points to invest in different areas The ability to choose a way to earn money Concluding contracts and developing your own business

Fealty is a classic tactical strategy game, available for solo or co-op play. It's simple yet challenging to master. So plan your strategy carefully, defeat every enemy in your path, and help your liege lord claim the crown. Discover this whimsical, procedurally generated island kingdom.

About the game
Seize the throne or bend the knee? 4X experience that you can play for about 1 or 2 hours! Can't wait to begin the incredible battle for the throne? Plus, develop your lands, increase your power, and force your opponents to bend the knee.

Make your enemies raise your banner and proclaim your place on the throne! It all begins when, in the absence of an heir, the nobles wage war for the throne. So, you have no choice but to find yourself in the thick of the battle. Are you prepared?

A compressed version of the stylized 4X Always a refreshing experience Unique diplomacy and more

Simply put, this is the authentic pirate game you've been dreaming about! It perfectly combines realistic ship combat with exploration of a vast open world.

Take on the role of a legendary pirate and live a life of freedom, plundering a fortune. Or perhaps you'd like to become a naval officer and serve the king? What about a wealthy merchant or a great explorer? The choice is yours, of course, but the adventure begins right now.

The motel – You're about to start your night shift at an old roadside stop. You're just going about your daily duties, but the evening news reports that a dangerous killer is just around the corner… Do you think you can survive until morning?

About the game
You work the night shift in a quiet roadside spot just outside the big city. Your job is fairly mundane: just maintaining order and keeping yourself occupied until morning.

At the very beginning, everything seems as usual, but after the news broadcast on the radio, nothing will be the same... Someone very dangerous is wandering nearby, will you be able to survive your night shift or will this place become your last stop?

Features of the game

At the very beginning, you will have a list of tasks from your boss that you need to complete gradually. However, as the night progresses, things will take a much more catastrophic turn. Discover one of several distinctive endings in this light horror/fun experience

Shadowgate 2 – Have you been waiting for it? The sequel to the reimagined point-and-click adventure is finally here! It's received critical acclaim and is available for pre-order.

About the game
2D adventures are a thing of the past, as entirely new horizons open up. And you can once again lift the veil of this mysterious castle! Magic is gradually fading from the lands of Cal Torlin, and shadows will once again begin to move across the land. You will take on the role of the sorceress Raven.

Can you bring ancient magic back to this world? Together with your sarcastic companion and the Chrono-Sphere, you'll journey directly to the source of the corruption. It's none other than the Shadow Gate Castle! It'll be full of treacherous creatures and impenetrable puzzles. To advance, you'll need to customize your own storybook and explore all the schools of magical spells.

19690.description:
Outworld Station is a strategy game in which you take control of a space station and develop it in a hostile galaxy. Your goal is to build a powerful industrial complex using resources and innovative technologies.

Strategy and resource management

Start with a small space complex and gradually expand it by building new factories, exploring planets, and mining rare materials. Use advanced technologies to build starships, extract resources, and create wormholes to connect different planets. Each new stage of your station's development requires a well-thought-out strategy: automating production and building efficient supply chains will be the foundation of your success.

Dynamic space battles and station defense from hostile forces add an element of risk to your expansive mission. Use alien artifacts to enhance your defenses and production capabilities. Develop stations on different planets and become a master of space construction.

Game features

Deep automation and resource management system. Creation of starships, weapons and defense systems. Development and expansion of stations in different parts of the galaxy. Exciting battles with hostile forces and the defense of your station.
